about: QRWTY arm A, Q04: every production binding of the Jeeves 4e87f97 export of revision 83 (Click events on Google Cloud), its owner, local value, production source, class, validation, local proof and the cloud assumption still unverified. 'proven' means exercised locally in Q04 with the evidence named; 'not run' means only Q12a/Q13 can show it. Status words follow local-to-cloud.md: locally verified; cloud activation pending.

owners.overlay: QRWTY arm A application overlay (infra/app-overlay: compose.override.yaml, scripts/qrwty-production-profile.mjs, infra/qrwty/production-profile.json)
owners.bootstrap: Q12a bootstrap (out of band; values never in Git or state)

bindings.localValue: local-postgres:5432 (compose.yaml); by address in the rehearsal
bindings.production: iac: /cloudsql/<connection name>, 5432 (Cloud Run's Cloud SQL volume)
bindings.validation: generated: Invalid endpoint when missing or malformed; overlay: refuses a Compose host name and any socket that is not /cloudsql/<project>:<region>:<instance>
bindings.assumption: Cloud Run's connector reaches a private-IP-only instance through Direct VPC egress

bindings.localValue: verify-full with the throwaway CA (test profile); disable in the bare export
bindings.production: iac: disable over the Unix socket (the connector encrypts; accepted under JEEVES_REQUIRE_TLS)
bindings.validation: generated: Insecure endpoint for disable over TCP under JEEVES_REQUIRE_TLS; overlay: same, plus no NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
bindings.assumption: Node cannot verify a Cloud SQL certificate named project:instance (QGR2 finding 13), so the socket is the production path

bindings.readBy: Redirect service, Link API (QG04, QG06, QG10)
bindings.production: iac: Memorystore discovery endpoint, verify-full, CA from secret qrwtya-memorystore-ca; servername unknown
bindings.validation: generated: Invalid/Insecure endpoint; overlay: same plus local host refusal
bindings.assumption: Memorystore's server certificate verifies against its managed CA by address or by a name Q12a reads

bindings.production: none: Memorystore AUTH_DISABLED; QRWTY_CACHE_AUTH_DISABLED=true gives an empty credential file
bindings.validation: overlay: an absent or empty cache secret only with QRWTY_CACHE_AUTH_DISABLED=true
bindings.assumption: Memorystore behaves as Valkey 8 does with no password (an empty or any AUTH accepted); IAM_AUTH is unusable (AG-04)

bindings.production: iac: var.project_id
bindings.validation: generated: project-ID shape; overlay: refuses local/test/demo projects
bindings.locally: proven (refusal); publish and consume on the emulator
bindings.assumption: Application Default Credentials from the service account on Cloud Run

bindings.production: absent
bindings.validation: generated: Insecure endpoint PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST under JEEVES_REQUIRE_TLS; overlay: refuses both
bindings.assumption: none

bindings.key: Pub/Sub topic click-events, subscription click-events--analytics-worker, dead letter click-events--analytics-worker.failed
bindings.readBy: compiled in the process files (no variable; AG-05)
bindings.localValue: created by setup-pubsub on the emulator
bindings.production: iac: google_pubsub_topic/subscription with 31-day retention, no expiry, storage in us-central1
bindings.validation: generated: the startup probe (topic or subscription exists)
bindings.locally: proven on the emulator (settings read back; dead letter with x-terminal-code)
bindings.assumption: Managed ACK durability, IAM, the dead-letter service agent and the Cloud Storage archive behave as documented

bindings.localValue: none: the emulator has no Cloud Storage subscription
bindings.production: iac: qrwtya-click-events-archive into qrwtya-click-archive-<project>, Avro with metadata, 31-day lifecycle
bindings.validation: lint_iac (structure only)
bindings.assumption: Objects carry the messageId attribute and land within 5 minutes

bindings.readBy: Link, Account and Billing API sign-ins (QG11, QG24)
bindings.localValue: Keycloak http://127.0.0.1:47202/realms/identity, identity-web (compose.yaml); an Auth0-shaped fixture issuer in the binding check
bindings.production: iac: https://<auth0 domain>/, A's API identifier, <issuer>.well-known/jwks.json
bindings.validation: generated: Invalid/Insecure endpoint (https under the switch), missing audience fails startup; overlay: tenant-issuer shape, JWKS equals issuer key set, not identity-web
evidence: records/r01-matrix-generated.jsonl (local-issuer named by the three guarded APIs)
bindings.assumption: Auth0's iss has a trailing slash and its access tokens carry A's audience; A's Auth0 application and API are created in Q12a/Q13

bindings.production: iac: https://<auth0 domain>
bindings.validation: generated: Invalid/Insecure endpoint; overlay: https origin only
bindings.assumption: The stub adds Auth0's own paths (Q07)

bindings.production: iac: deterministic https://qrwtya-<id>-<project number>.us-central1.run.app
bindings.validation: generated: Invalid/Insecure endpoint; overlay: https, no local host
bindings.locally: proven (validation only; no tile call is written yet)
bindings.assumption: Internal-only ingress with invoker IAM off admits calls from Direct VPC egress and refuses the Internet

bindings.production: iac and overlay: exactly https://api.stripe.com and https://webrisk.googleapis.com
bindings.validation: generated: required (Invalid endpoint until set), https under the switch; overlay: fixed values (fake-provider)
bindings.locally: proven (validation only; no provider call yet)
bindings.assumption: Provider credentials are read by product code from SECRET_DIR files (Q07-Q10a)

bindings.production: iac: true

bindings.assumption: none

bindings.production: absent
bindings.validation: overlay: refuses both; generated: neither (AG-02)

bindings.validation: overlay

bindings.assumption: none

bindings.production: set only by the container command to /tmp/qrwty-secrets after the preflight links each mounted secret
bindings.validation: overlay: refused when set by the environment
bindings.locally: proven (Cloud Run-shaped mount layout in every profile-mode start)

bindings.readBy: the process named in the login, and the migration job (sets the password on first run)
bindings.production: bootstrap: Secret Manager qrwtya-sql-<db>--<tile>, mounted as <mount>/<name>/value
bindings.validation: overlay: present, not a placeholder or development value
bindings.assumption: Rotation is not supported: migrate.mjs never changes an existing login's password (G09 credential rotation stays open)

bindings.production: bootstrap: Secret Manager; postgres-admin equals the Cloud SQL postgres password set out of band
bindings.validation: overlay (migrate)
bindings.locally: proven with a CREATEDB CREATEROLE non-superuser admin
bindings.assumption: Cloud SQL's postgres user is CREATEDB CREATEROLE and PostgreSQL 16+ GRANT … WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE works there

bindings.readBy: the migration job (the local Keycloak's database)
bindings.production: bootstrap: Secret Manager, unused by Auth0 (AG-06)
bindings.validation: overlay (migrate)
bindings.assumption: An unused database i_identity on Cloud SQL is harmless

bindings.class: public (in Secret Manager only as a file-mount mechanism)
bindings.production: iac: version from managed_server_ca
bindings.validation: generated: Unreadable CA file
bindings.assumption: Both instances share one managed CA

bindings.production: iac: container_port 3000, startup and liveness probes on /healthz, Cloud Run's 10 s SIGTERM window
bindings.validation: oracle R03
bindings.locally: proven (10 replicas drained in 0.6-1.5 s over two oracle runs, exit 0; 12,117 requests through a drain and restart all 202)
bindings.assumption: Cloud Run delivers SIGTERM to the exec'd node process (the shell execs it)

bindings.readBy: generated databaseClient (10 per copy per login, 2 s statements, 2.5 s client bound)
bindings.production: iac: max_instance_count (default 3) per service
bindings.validation: oracle R03 connection check
bindings.locally: proven (max 20 connections for 2 copies under 32 concurrent clients)
bindings.assumption: Cloud SQL db-f1-micro's connection limit covers max_instances x 10 x logins; requote at Q15

bindings.localValue: qrwtya-q04-app (non-root node, one image for all)
bindings.production: iac: var.image pinned by digest
bindings.validation: variable validation (digest required)
bindings.assumption: The pushed digest's config equals the local one; the local image ID varies with Compose's service label
